scope: 12 predeclared market-only rule variants; all development returns disclosed

scorers.P4: unchanged production percentile scorer using frozen P4_equal_categories weights
scorers.risk_liquidity: 0.5 * mean(percentile ranks of the three frozen risk members) + 0.5 * turnover percentile; all seven common factors must remain finite

candidates.name: 取消放量门槛+波动率分配
取消放量门槛+风控流动性排序
风控流动性+波动率分配+15%仓位控制

selection.primary: candidates passing every frozen development gate, ordered by mean index excess at 10bps, then same-pool excess, then lower traded notional
selection.fallback: if none pass, candidates satisfying both -15% loss/drawdown gates ordered as primary; if none satisfy risk gates, lowest worst drawdown, then mean index excess
selection.holdout: test only frozen finalist plus O00 baseline; do not select among candidates on holdout
selection.attempts: exactly these 12 variants; factor diagnostic is not used to introduce further trial weights

timing: all scores, vol weights and market-volatility exposure use previous-close information; order execution uses the scheduled open; final exits use last close
market_exposure: min(1, annual_vol_target / previous_close_20day_CSI_All_Share_price_return_population_volatility / sqrt(252)); no leverage; apply same rule to pool control
buffer: retain actual holdings still eligible and within retain_rank, in rank order; fill remaining slots by rank; blocked inventory remains in NAV and occupies slots
reference_policy: same-pool equal portfolio with same calendar, costs and market exposure; full-investment equal reference retained; inverse-vol pool reference additionally reported for inverse-vol candidates
